title: BookIt Services
problem_statement: People often have difficulty finding and booking reliable local services. Whether looking for a plumber, tutor, or personal trainer, the process can be frustrating and time-consuming. BookIt will create a simple marketplace that connects service providers with customers who need help with various tasks.
target_users: People who need to find and book local services
Service providers who want to attract more customers
Busy professionals who need help with various household and personal tasks
user_stories: As a customer, I want to find local service providers easily so that I can get help when I need it
As a service provider, I want to list my services and availability so that potential customers can find and book me
As a customer, I want to read reviews so that I can choose a trustworthy and reliable service provider
As a service provider, I want to manage my bookings and schedule so that I can run my business efficiently
acceptance_criteria: Customers should be able to search for services available in their local area
Service providers should be able to create profiles and list their services and rates
Booking and payment should be a straightforward and secure process
Reviews and ratings should be clearly visible to help customers make decisions

success_metrics.metric: Number of bookings completed through the platform
success_metrics.target: Growing number of successful bookings over time

success_metrics.metric: Service provider satisfaction with the platform
success_metrics.target: Service providers find value in using the platform
Customers come back to book additional services

risks_open_questions: Competition from established platforms like TaskRabbit and Thumbtack will be significant
Building sufficient trust between customers and service providers from the start
Ensuring quality control and proper vetting of service providers on the platform
out_of_scope: International market expansion in the first version
B2B service marketplace for business clients
Advanced scheduling, calendar, and availability management features
